channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Gaza conflict: Israeli strike kills 5, resident decries neighbor's death
item.description: An Israeli air attack on a residential apartment in Gaza killed five Palestinians. A Gaza resident decried the killing of his Christian neighbors by Israelis as a truce nears its one-year anniversary. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
